title: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 Remastered following criticism over AI-generated graphics
summary: Sega removes the Shogun 2 remaster from stores and restores the original after players reported poor quality.

title: Rockstar reveals GTA 6 launch trailer featuring Lucia and Jason
summary: GTA 6 will have its launch trailer with chase scenes, heists, and intimate moments between its protagonists.

title: House House will not release Big Walk on Xbox due to supporting BDS boycott against Microsoft
summary: Big Walk creators announce the game will not arrive on Xbox while Microsoft remains a target of the pro-Palestinian BDS boycott.

title: Jagex cancels RuneScape Reignited following wave of player criticism
summary: Jagex backs down on RuneScape Reignited less than two weeks after announcing it due to negative community response.

title: Riot Games ends League of Legends Classic as permanent mode
summary: Riot announces that League of Legends Classic will cease to be a permanent mode in January 2027, although it could return as a limited event.

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse game receives reviews and unlock guides
summary: Various outlets publish reviews and guides on Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, covering weapons, skins, and movement skills.

title: Battlefield 6 free trial and reverted experience changes
summary: Battlefield 6 offers a new free trial and reverts controversial experience changes that the studio called unintentional.

title: Modern Warfare 4 data magazine and possible strike by unionized Activision testers
summary: Unionized Activision testers vote to authorize a strike while negotiating contracts for Modern Warfare 4.

title: Releases and updates for current and next-generation console games
summary: Various titles announce release dates, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series versions, as well as expansions and early access.
